sanskrit: sarva gaḥ sarva bhūta ātmā sarva bhūta bhava udbhavaḥ
english: Thou art he that pervadest all things, that art the Soul of all things, thou art the Creator of the Creator of all entities.

sanskrit: ajñaḥ ca aśraddadhānaḥ ca saṃśaya ātmā vinaśyati
english: One who hath no knowledge and no faith, and whose minds is full of doubt, is lost.

sanskrit: sa kṛcchra kālam saṃprāpya vyathām na eva eti karhi cit
english: Accordingly, when the hour of death approacheth, he feeleth no pangs.
the only one who cuts them off is the rationalist.
